title: H-SCHEDSTATION-1: on a MERGED pair the member edits the PARTNER's shop schedule; a shift naming an employee who exists on the member but is not assigned to that shop there must not kill the station row when the owner's echo redraws the tab. The host (member) opens Client1's gym '60 ba:street_fifthavenue' Schedule tab, adds a shift through the game's own add-shift call (ScheduleHelper.AddWorkShift) for such an employee, runs the page's own row reload, waits for the owner's answer and reads the rows. Before the fix the row-killing error appears in the log (oracles_absent fails); after it the row stays with its sliders. Ends dissolved; NO save.
preconditions: Reporter fixture fx-hq1 (MERGED pair melaus + Client1; vars.keepMerger true). Dev build with the levers schedrows / schedtab / shiftat (BAMP_DEV). Client1 owns the gym '60 ba:street_fifthavenue' with at least one scheduled shift. NOTHING is saved; the run ends dissolved and the fixture reset restores the pair.

steps.note: BASELINE on the member, tab closed: the rows the page would build, the employees it can colour, each shift and where its employee is assigned HERE; cand = an employee named by one of the gym's shifts who exists here but is not on the page's list
the OWNER's view of the same day (where each employee is assigned on the owner)
the member opens the partner's gym Schedule tab on that day

the member adds a shift for cand (a partner staff copy assigned to ANOTHER shop here) through ScheduleHelper.AddWorkShift (a native throw is caught and reported as addErr), then runs the page's own row reload (RequestScheduleScrollerReload, what native AddWorkShift does next): THE ASSERTION - the reload draws every row without throwing

expect_log.regex: \[ScheduleDiag\] SetUp: shift names employee ${cand} not assigned to this shop here \(assigned to [^)]*\) - drawn neutral

steps.note: REPORT: the rows right after the reload (slider counts include sliders the reload queued for destruction; the owner's answer may already have replaced the day)
2 s scan -> owner validates -> owner truth / echo -> RedrawScheduleTab
after the owner's answer: every station row still drawn, its sliders = its cached shifts
did the owner take the shift
the phone closed as the player would (a BizMan left open at quit NREs in CityMapFilters)
FIXTURE HYGIENE: end dissolved; NO save
